_meta.note: Intra-Qur'anic mapping. Each theme is anchored on one or more Arabic roots (tri/quadriliteral). The roots are the reference; terms_ar/terms_fr only capture forms outside the root. No exegetical source.
categories: Human Psychology and States of the Soul

creation.label: Creation (al-ḫalq)
creation.description: Root خ-ل-ق: to create, shape, measure.

etre.label: Being / existence (al-kawn)
etre.description: Root ك-و-ن: to be, to come to be.

resurrection.label: The raising (al-baʿṯ)
resurrection.description: Root ب-ع-ث: to resurrect, send, raise.

naissance.label: Birth / the child (al-walad)
naissance.description: Root و-ل-د: to beget, be born, child, parents.

veracite.label: Truthfulness (aṣ-ṣidq)
veracite.description: Root ص-د-ق: truth, sincerity, truthful alms.

repentir.label: Repentance (at-tawba)
repentir.description: Root ت-و-ب: to turn toward, return.

piete.label: Piety / God-consciousness (at-taqwā)
piete.description: Root و-ق-ي: to guard against, to fear.

mensonge.label: Lying (al-kiḏb)
mensonge.description: Root ك-ذ-ب: to lie, to deny.

avarice.label: Miserliness (al-buḫl)
avarice.description: Root ب-خ-ل: to stint, to be miserly.

effacement.label: Pardoning / effacement (al-ʿafw)
effacement.description: Root ع-ف-و: to pardon, erase, be forbearing.

paix.label: Peace / submission (as-salām)
paix.description: Root س-ل-م: peace, salutation, submission, integrity.

trahison.label: Betrayal (al-ḫiyāna)
trahison.description: Root خ-و-ن: to betray, to be disloyal.

coeur.label: The heart (al-qalb)
coeur.description: Root ق-ل-ب: heart, turning, seat of intention.

ame.label: The soul / the self (an-nafs)
ame.description: Root ن-ف-س: soul, self, vital breath.

rappel.label: Remembrance (aḏ-ḏikr)
rappel.description: Root ذ-ك-ر: to mention, remember, remind.

espoir.label: Hope (ar-rajāʾ)
espoir.description: Root ر-ج-و: to hope, to expect.

desespoir.label: Despair (al-qunūṭ)
desespoir.description: Root ق-ن-ط: to despair, to lose hope.

foi.label: Faith (al-īmān)
foi.description: Root أ-م-ن: to believe, faith, security, trust.

mecreance.label: Disbelief (al-kufr)
mecreance.description: Root ك-ف-ر: to reject, cover, deny.

association.label: Associationism (aš-širk)
association.description: Root ش-ر-ك: to associate, to share.

conjecture.label: Conjecture (aẓ-ẓann)
conjecture.description: Root ظ-ن-ن: to suppose, conjecture, believe.

priere.label: The ritual prayer (aṣ-ṣalāt)
priere.description: Root ص-ل-و: to pray, bless, bow.

aumone.label: The purifying alms (az-zakāt)
aumone.description: Root ز-ك-و: to purify, make grow, alms.

pelerinage.label: Pilgrimage (al-ḥajj)
pelerinage.description: Root ح-ج-ج: to make pilgrimage, to set out.

mariage.label: Marriage (an-nikāḥ)
mariage.description: Root ن-ك-ح: to contract marriage, wed.

divorce.label: Divorce (aṭ-ṭalāq)
divorce.description: Root ط-ل-ق: to repudiate, to release.

heritage.label: Inheritance (al-irt)
heritage.description: Root و-ر-ث: to inherit, leave as inheritance.

serment.label: The oath (al-qasam)
serment.description: Root ق-س-م: to swear, oath, share.

jugement.label: Judgment / wisdom (al-ḥukm)
jugement.description: Root ح-ك-م: to judge, decide, wisdom.

legislation.label: Legislation (aš-šarīʿa)
legislation.description: Root ش-ر-ع: to prescribe, establish a way.

interdiction.label: Prohibition (at-taḥrīm)
interdiction.description: Root ح-ر-م: to forbid, make sacred, sacred.

liceite.label: The lawful (al-ḥalāl)
liceite.description: Root ح-ل-ل: to permit, lawful, to undo.

nourriture.label: Food (aṭ-ṭaʿām)
nourriture.description: Root أ-ك-ل: to eat, to feed.

temoignage.label: Testimony (aš-šahāda)
temoignage.description: Root ش-ه-د: to testify, to bear witness.

immolation.label: Sacrificial slaughter (aḏ-ḏabḥ)
immolation.description: Root ذ-ب-ح: to slaughter, to sacrifice.

seigneur.label: The Lord (ar-rabb)
seigneur.description: Root ر-ب-ب: lord, master, to nurture.

djinn.label: The jinn (al-jinn)
djinn.description: Root ج-ن-ن: jinn, what is veiled (also garden).

invisible.label: The unseen (al-ġayb)
invisible.description: Root غ-ي-ب: what is hidden, the occult.

livre.label: The Book (al-kitāb)
livre.description: Root ك-ت-ب: to write, book, prescribe.

messagers.label: The messengers (ar-rusul)
messagers.description: Root ر-س-ل: to send, messenger, prophet.

balance.label: The balance (al-mīzān)
balance.description: Root و-ز-ن: to weigh, balance, equilibrium.

compte.label: The reckoning / requital (al-ḥisāb)
compte.description: Root ح-س-ب: to count, to settle accounts.

retribution.label: Retribution (al-jazāʾ)
retribution.description: Root ج-ز-ي: to requite, to reward.

jardin.label: The garden (al-janna)
jardin.description: Root ج-ن-ن: garden, what is veiled.

decret.label: The decree (al-qadar)
decret.description: Root ق-د-ر: to measure, destine, have power.

science.label: Knowledge (al-ʿilm)
science.description: Root ع-ل-م: to know, knowledge, science.

raison.label: Reason (al-ʿaql)
raison.description: Root ع-ق-ل: to reason, to understand.

recitation.label: Recitation (al-qurʾān / al-qirāʾa)
recitation.description: Root ق-ر-أ: to read, recite, proclaim.

parole.label: Speech (al-qawl)
parole.description: Root ق-و-ل: to say, speech, utterance.

ouie.label: Hearing (as-samʿ)
ouie.description: Root س-م-ع: to hear, to listen.

vue.label: Sight (al-baṣar)
vue.description: Root ب-ص-ر: to see, vision, insight.

jour.label: The day (al-yawm)
jour.description: Root ي-و-م: day, the Last Day.

commencement.label: The beginning (al-badʾ)
commencement.description: Root ب-د-أ: to begin, create, initiate.

peuple.label: The people (al-qawm)
peuple.description: Root ق-و-م: people, tribe, to rise.

successeurs.label: The successors (al-ḫulafāʾ)
successeurs.description: Root خ-ل-ف: to succeed, replace, behind.

voyage.label: The journey (as-sayr)
voyage.description: Root س-ي-ر: to walk, travel, journey.

subsistance.label: Provision (ar-rizq)
subsistance.description: Root ر-ز-ق: to provide, provision, gift.

perte.label: Loss (al-ḫusrān)
perte.description: Root خ-س-ر: to lose, to fail.

depense.label: Spending (al-infāq)
depense.description: Root ن-ف-ق: to spend, to give out.

opulence.label: Affluence (al-ġinā)
opulence.description: Root غ-ن-ي: wealth, to be free of need.

indigents.label: The needy (al-masākīn)
indigents.description: Root س-ك-ن: poor, destitute (also to dwell).

reconciliation.label: Reconciliation (aṣ-ṣulḥ)
reconciliation.description: Root ص-ل-ح: to reform, reconcile, good.

conseil.label: Sincere counsel (an-nuṣḥ)
conseil.description: Root ن-ص-ح: to counsel, be sincere.

rassemblement.label: Gathering (al-jamʿ)
rassemblement.description: Root ج-م-ع: to gather, assemble, community.

division.label: Division (al-furqa)
division.description: Root ف-ر-ق: to separate, divide, distinguish.
